title: Typing Hooks
description: Learn how to type custom hooks and common React hooks.
longDescription: React hooks are the building blocks of modern React applications, but typing them correctly requires special attention. This module dives into useEffect cleanup types, useRef for DOM and mutable values, and building your own typed custom hooks with generics. You'll learn patterns for returning tuples vs objects and when to use explicit generics.
whatYouLearn: Use useRef for DOM and mutable values
Create typed custom hooks with generics
Return tuples or objects from hooks
